en-US.title: Circular Fash
en-US.subtitle: Authenticated pre-owned luxury
en-US.description:
Circular Fash is the home for authenticated pre-owned luxury fashion — a curated archive of one-of-one pieces from the world's most sought-after houses, each verified and condition-graded in-house.

Browse a live catalog of Moncler, Gucci, Stone Island, C.P. Company, Louis Vuitton, Prada, Burberry and more. Because almost every piece is unique — a single item that never restocks — what you see is what's genuinely available, updated in real time.

WHAT YOU'LL FIND
• Authenticated luxury — every item verified against brand references, with condition honestly graded.
• One-of-one inventory — unique pieces, shown against original retail so you see the value at a glance.
• Real-time availability — sold pieces are marked instantly; new arrivals land continuously.
• Secure checkout — buy in a few taps through Shopify's trusted, secure checkout.

ABOUT CIRCULAR FASH
Circular Fash is a Sweden-based destination for authentic pre-owned luxury. Every piece passes through our in-house authentication and grading before it reaches you.

Questions about an order or a specific item? Reach us any time at circularfash.com.
en-US.promoText: Authenticated pre-owned luxury — Moncler, Gucci, Stone Island, Louis Vuitton & more. One-of-one pieces, each verified in-house. New drops land continuously.

review.notes:
Circular Fash AB is a Sweden-based registered retailer (org. nr 559449-3966) of authentic pre-owned luxury fashion, operating the storefront at circularfash.com. Every item in the app is a genuine second-hand piece that we authenticate and condition-grade in-house before listing; we are the seller of these physical goods.

The app is a browse-and-buy catalog of our own inventory. Brand names and logos appear only to accurately describe the authentic pre-owned items we resell; we do not claim affiliation with or endorsement by these brands.

Checkout uses Shopify's secure hosted checkout for physical goods shipped to the customer. There are no digital goods or in-app purchases, and no account/login is required — so no demo credentials are needed.
